newsitem.title: USA: Jacobs group may seek control of Pinnacle.
newsitem.headline: Jacobs group may seek control of Pinnacle.

text.p: A group led by Minneapolis investor Irwin Jacobs said on Thursday it has acquired a 5.78 percent stake in Pinnacle Systems Inc and "may determine to seek control of the company."
The group, which paid $4.76 million for its stake of 432,800 common shares, said it bought the stake because it believes the shares are undervalued.
Before it decides to seek control, the group said it may explore other steps such as making a proposal to the company for a merger or buying additional shares.
It said it may also consider entering into arrangements with third parties who may be interested in joining the group to acquire control of Pinnacle.
Such arrangements may involve the sale of parts of Pinnacle's assets to such third parties after control is obtained, it said.

Separately, Pinnacle, a maker of video post-production tools for broadcast and desktop applications, announced on Thursday its board has adopted an antitakeover defence measure through a preferred share purchase rights plan.
The measure is designed to make it prohibitively expensive for a group which acquires, or plans to make a tender offer, for a 15 percent stake or more in the company.
